declareWinner(uint8).details: Declare the winner as an owner.  Note that in case no one funded for the winner when the owner makes its transaction, having someone else deposit to get the reward is fine and doesn't affect the mecanism.

params._winner: The party that is eligible to a reward according to owner.

deposit(uint8).details: Make a deposit as one of the parties.

params._side: A party to make a deposit as.

payReward().details: Pay the reward to the winner. Reimburse the surplus deposit for both parties if there was one.
